title: Arts After Dark: A Luxury Networking Night & Art Exhibition in Las Vegas
excerpt: Join Black Lobby Collective for Arts After Dark—an elevated networking night + art exhibition in Las Vegas. Jan 10, 2026, 6–10 PM. Tickets available.
alt: Guests networking at a luxury art exhibition in Las Vegas hosted by Black Lobby Collective
content:
There are evenings that feel curated—meant to be remembered, not just attended. Arts After Dark, hosted by Black Lobby Collective, is one of those nights: an elevated art exhibition designed for meaningful connection, high design, and the kind of conversation that sparks collaborations.

On January 10, 2026 (6:00–10:00 PM), we invite Las Vegas creatives, collectors, founders, and culture-builders into a refined space where art is the anchor—and networking becomes effortless.

What is Arts After Dark?

Arts After Dark is a luxury-forward gathering where you can:

  • Experience curated artwork in an intimate exhibition setting
  • Meet artists, designers, and community leaders in a calm, premium environment
  • Connect with people who move with intention—collectors, collaborators, and builders
  • Step into the world of Black Lobby Collective: art, design, and future museum-grade experiences

This is not a loud party. It's not a crowded mixer. It's an art-centered, relationship-first evening built for people who want more than small talk.

Event Details

  • Date: Saturday, January 10, 2026
  • Time: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
  • Venue: Arts After Dark
  • Address: 1551 S Commerce St, Las Vegas, NV
  • Host: Black Lobby Collective

Dress Code

Black & white attire only. Clean lines. Minimal. Museum-ready. (Think gallery opening, not nightclub.)

Ticket Options

Choose the experience that fits your evening:

1) Networking & Exhibition Ticket — $12

Perfect for guests who want to:

  • Network with artists + professionals
  • Walk the exhibition
  • Build relationships and discover new work

2) Charcuterie Board & Wine Room Ticket — $18

Includes everything above, plus access to:

  • The Wine Room experience
  • Charcuterie board + elevated refreshments
  • A more intimate conversation environment for deeper connection

What to Expect Inside

A curated arrival. You'll enter a space designed for presence—artwork, lighting, and ambiance arranged to feel intentional, not chaotic.

A real exhibition experience. Whether you're an artist, collector, or simply someone who appreciates craft, you'll be able to engage the work without the rush.

Networking that actually works. Arts After Dark is engineered for quality interactions—people who are building brands, collecting art, curating rooms, commissioning pieces, hosting events, and shaping culture in Las Vegas and beyond.

A future-forward brand world. Black Lobby Collective is building more than events—we're building an institution: premium art, design objects, workshops, and curated experiences with museum-level ambition.

Who This Event is For

If any of these sound like you, this night is yours:

  • Artists looking for community, collectors, and curated opportunities
  • Interior designers seeking bold, statement work and unique creators
  • Hotel, gallery, museum, and venue teams scouting partnerships and programming
  • Founders + entrepreneurs who value culture and high-caliber relationships
  • Collectors interested in discovering emerging and established talent
  • Anyone who wants to be in rooms where creativity is treated like legacy

Why Arts After Dark Matters

Las Vegas has energy—but too often, creative connection gets lost in noise. Arts After Dark is a different frequency: intentional, elevated, and relationship-driven.

This is how ecosystems get built:

  • One conversation that turns into a collaboration
  • One introduction that becomes a commission
  • One night that becomes a tradition

How to Prepare

  • Wear black & white
  • Arrive early if you want quieter exhibition time
  • Bring business cards—or a clean QR code/contact card
  • Come ready to introduce yourself in one sentence: "I'm ___, and I create/build ___ for ___."

Tickets + Next Steps

Tickets are available now. If you've been looking for a room that feels elevated, creative, and genuinely connected—this is your invitation.

Secure your ticket today and step into Arts After Dark.

FAQ

Is this event 21+?
If alcohol is being served in the Wine Room, guests should be prepared to show ID.

Can I come alone?
Absolutely. This is one of the best types of events to attend solo—people are here to meet.

Is there parking?
Arrive a few minutes early and plan for city parking/lot access near the venue.

What if I only want the exhibition?
The $12 ticket is built exactly for that—exhibition + networking.

title: The Art of Tufting: From Yarn to Luxury Rug
excerpt: Discover the meticulous process behind creating handcrafted luxury tufted rugs. Learn about material selection, design planning, and the techniques that transform premium yarns into timeless art pieces.
alt: Gods Collection gallery installation featuring luxury tufted rugs in modern gallery setting
content:
Welcome to the intricate world of tufting, where premium yarns transform into timeless luxury art pieces. At Black Lobby Collective, we've dedicated ourselves to mastering this ancient craft, blending traditional techniques with contemporary artistic vision.

The Foundation: Understanding Tufting

Tufting is more than a craft—it's a form of artistic expression that dates back centuries. Unlike machine-made rugs, hand-tufted pieces carry the unique imprint of the artist, creating one-of-a-kind works that tell stories through texture, color, and design.

title: Contemporary Art Meets Traditional Craftsmanship
excerpt: How Black Lobby bridges the gap between contemporary artistic expression and time-honored tufting techniques. Exploring the dialogue between modern aesthetics and artisanal tradition.
alt: Gods Collection luxury tufted rug in elegant contemporary living room interior design
content: In the world of luxury design, there exists a beautiful tension between contemporary artistic expression and traditional craftsmanship. At Black Lobby Collective, we embrace this dialogue, creating pieces that honor both worlds.
